articles.explain: The DGTR (Directorate General of Trade Remedies) ensures a level playing field for domestic businesses. By setting import caps, the government regulates supply levels. This move aims to prevent Indian companies from being undercut by foreign competitors while local manufacturers work to scale up their own operations.

story.title: Soda Ash Import Restrictions
story.so_far: The DGTR is an arm of the Indian Ministry of Commerce that investigates unfair trade practices and recommends protective duties or quotas. Soda ash is a vital chemical used in glass, detergent, and chemical manufacturing. Domestic manufacturers have periodically lobbied for protection against cheaper imported materials.

timeline.text: Regulators recommended quarterly import limits and country-specific quotas to stabilize the local market.

articles.source: Business News Today: Latest Business New
articles.summary: Gujarat Energy has finalized a 10-year agreement to purchase liquefied natural gas (LNG) from ADNOC.
articles.explain: LNG (Liquefied Natural Gas) is natural gas that has been cooled to a liquid state for easier transport across oceans. A 10-year contract provides 'energy security' by guaranteeing a steady supply of fuel at a negotiated price, shielding the buyer from extreme price spikes in the volatile global energy market.

articles.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains starting in 2027
articles.summary: Greece has introduced a 10% tax on cryptocurrency capital gains, beginning in 2027.
articles.explain: A crypto tax is a levy on profits made when selling digital assets like Bitcoin for more than they were purchased. DeFi, or Decentralized Finance, refers to financial services (like lending or trading) built on blockchain technology that operate without traditional intermediaries like banks. This matters because it signals a shift toward stricter government oversight of digital asset wealth.

story.title: Greece Crypto Taxation Policy
story.so_far: Countries globally are increasingly formalizing regulatory frameworks for digital assets. Taxing crypto gains is a step toward bringing decentralized finance (DeFi) and digital currencies into the traditional fiscal fold, allowing governments to generate tax revenue from the crypto market.

timeline.text: The Greek government approved a 10% tax on crypto gains and a 15% levy on DeFi income, with a small profit exemption for lower-earning investors.

articles.title: Penny stock under ₹10 hits 5% upper circuit on Dhanteras 2026 date; finds no seller for third straight session
articles.summary: An unidentified penny stock priced under ₹10 has hit its upper circuit limit for three consecutive days.
articles.explain: When a stock 'hits the upper circuit' and finds 'no sellers,' it means demand is so high that no one is willing to sell their shares at the current price, causing the price to stop moving upward for the day. This is common in highly speculative, low-liquidity small-cap stocks.
